input_routes.source_object_verbatim: nucleotide sequences from the NCBI nt Database
transformation_chain_verbatim: curate sequence data along with corresponding textual annotations from the NCBI nt Database up to April, 2023
truncate sequences longer than 3000 bp to 3000 bp with a sliding window approach
exclude sequences with length less than 200 bp
filter out sequences containing equal to or more than two consecutive N nucleotides
organize the sequence data with the text annotations as feature-ordered input for model pre-training
partition into sentence-based chunks
tokenize with SentencePiece using byte pair encoding
prepend <s> and append </s>

input_routes.text_role_verbatim: paired input in the pre-training prompt
input_routes.evidence_quote: The prompt is composed of three modules: 1. an instruction; 2. a nucleotide sequence; 3. an annotation.
